name: Telegram
tagline: A cloud-based mobile and desktop messaging app.
description: Telegram is a cloud-based mobile and desktop messaging app.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  app:
    image: linuxserver/telegram:7.3.2@sha256:e0acac08866ee19cfc46840083fd75c5aefd19559126182c9c27702dfe66d205
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      PUID: $PUID
      PGID: $PGID
      TZ: $TZ
    ports:
      - target: 3000
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
      - target: 3001
        published: 3001
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config
        target: /config
